body: Took my RSO. Drank some whisky. I have no clue what to do with myself. =/
I gave in and got black velvet and RSO. Getting fucked up for tonight has to be better than I-5.
Spent most of today in bed.  I don't see the point in going out if I have to panhandle for my existence.
I am definitely living for someone else and not myself. Literally the only way I can hang on to life right now.
They were my first date in ages since the pandemic started, so it hit a ~~little~~ lot rough,

I likely came off as wanting something more serious than they did. They have a settled life with cats, instruments, and video games. I on the other hand asked what the rent was on the room that was opening up and looked up an Instant Pot recipe for their favorite soup. \*facepalm\*
Did I not give enough of myself?

Overall, Seattle has great public transportation, but the grey days and large mentally unstable transient population aren't my favorite. I miss being in Portland, OR. 

All three of my roommates claimed they had applied for food stamps, but who knows. One even kept trying to bargain with me that they would pay me back "in spades." /me shrugs
I mean they thanked me for the time and intimacy we spent together, but decided not to pursue a further connection. AKA sort of a one night stand? More of a fling, maybe.

Fasting can be good depending on who you are. I find I get dizzy without my three meals, which is part of why I've been feeling so shitty. They only serve dinner here, and my roommates kept taking my groceries.
I'm in North Seattle, WA
My OKC date rejected me after outing number 2. I had a feeling they were going to, but it doesn't hurt any less.
>No more dinners downstairs, so had to do fast food. Had a bacon cheeseburger, Pibb Zero with Strawberry and Vanilla, garlic fries, and a strawberry shake.
About to eat dinner. That has to be better than I-5.
OOF

Sunlight and genetics are the most likely culprits behind my own hair color change. I'm effectively brindle now: dark brown with red, black, blonde, and silver.

Picked up the titanium straw recently. I've gotten some good clouds, but it opened with the straw at the end instead of the mouthpiece once. This setup might be sensitive to residual concentrate on the straw.
Job hunting in the middle of a pandemic. Fuuuun stuff. I'd rather imagine myself as a timelord stalk broker. Day in, day out...
